# Sales Templates

<!-- BREADCRUMB PLACEHOLDER -->

This directory contains templates used during the sales and pre-sales process for capturing solution requirements that drive infrastructure sizing and cost estimation.
page_texts.2:
[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/README.md#templates]

## Templates

- [Solution Cost Input](solution-cost-input-template.md) - ITO hosting and costing input for infrastructure sizing, cost estimation, and environment provisioning
- [Solution Cost Output](solution-cost-output-template.md) - AI Reviewer and ITO team output documenting review findings, readiness assessment, and sizing recommendations
page_texts.3:
[resources/work-templates/assets/sales/README.md#usage]

## Usage

These templates support the sales process by providing:

- Standardized capture of hosting, compute, storage, and networking requirements
- Consistent inputs for ITO infrastructure sizing and cost modeling
- Clear documentation of scalability, disaster recovery, and compliance needs
- Alignment between sales commitments and infrastructure delivery
